label: AI Insight UI — Admin (Keycloak proxy)
info:
Pure UIBUILDER read-only Keycloak Admin proxy per FAP §10. Three actions:
  admin.users   — list users in the FACIS realm
  admin.roles   — list realm roles + member counts
  admin.access  — recent login/logout/role-change events

Authentication is migrated from HTTP Authorization header to msg._req.payload.authToken — the Vue layer attaches the user's Keycloak access token in the command payload. Server-side validation (Keycloak userinfo + admin role check) is otherwise unchanged.

Requires environment: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_URL, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM (default 'facis').
